notes: Each frozen reference epoch is evaluated separately; never sum arc progress across rebuilt references.
Each sample is current pre-act measured XY paired with the full installed reference after that one call; reference installation is a decision, not proof of prior exposure.
Last epoch sample is the final request pre-state, not the final postphysics arrival state. Original navigation scoring remains authoritative.
Arc intervals preserve self-overlap ambiguity; no policy path_index or heading chooses a convenient projection.
Raw waypoint direction labels are logged content, not independently inferred actual movement.
